description: Compute embedding vectors for a context's chunks with its bound embedding model, as a background job. By default only chunks without a vector are embedded (resume); reembed=true recomputes all vectors in place. Returns {job_id}; poll job_status. The context needs an embedding model (create_context / update_context).

reembed.description: Recompute every vector (default false: only missing ones).

name: embed_context
